values.title: F231 definition
values.finding: Siemens operating instructions G85139-H1751-U529-D1, page 64: output current measurement imbalance; cross-reference F002 on page 63. This is a fault definition, not proof of a particular failed part.

values.title: Disconnected-motor report

values.title: Reset and recurrence
values.finding: Temporary clearing, three initially fault-free cycles and later recurrence do not establish reliability. One user correction says reset then start, without chatter.

values.title: PE10 / PE11

values.title: Meter readings

values.title: Direction / speed

values.title: Maintenance baseline
